description:
You don’t get a second life.
You don’t get a practice round.

So stop walking toward what you want.
Run.

Edit by @thryv.on
transcript: One life. Just one. Why aren't we running like we're on fire towards our wildest dreams? We got one shot at this. Why aren't we like the crazy one? I want people to look at me like that guy is nuts. Good, I got one shot at this life. I'd rather you call me crazy and a dreamer than a settler. You're not made to stand alone and blend in. You're made to stand out.
